about_the_game:
WANT TO SURVIVE THE SERIALS OF KILLER CHAT? OR BETTER YET, KISS THEM SILLY?

This is the official companion book to Killer Chat! Original Edition and the Overkill DLC, walking you through all the romance routes and all the endings of the game, as well as unravelling secret bonus moments, easter eggs, and more! It also includes a guide to unlocking everything possible in the Overkill DLC, and exclusive behind-the-scenes commentary from the director, rosesrot. 

What are you waiting for? Let the writing — err, murdering — commence! 

After purchase, you may access the DLC via:

Gear icon in Killer Chat! Original Edition's Library page.

1. Go to your Library in the Steam client

2. Select Killer Chat! Original Edition and on Killer Chat! Original Edition's Library page select the gear icon.

3. Select Properties... from the menu that appears.

4. Select Installed Files and press "Browse..."

5. The game's folder will appear with Killer Chat! Original Edition - Official Guidebook within it.
